name: wechat-search/v2/search-videos
description: Search WeChat Channels videos by keyword with duration, sort (relevance, newest, most liked) and publish-time filters. Returns titles, creators, duration, likes and publish time.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Optional, default True. True=raw search response; False=simplified parsing.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Optional, default `default`. Sort — `default`/0 (relevance) / `latest`/1 (newest) / `hot`/2 (most liked); string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Optional. Pagination cursor, same usage as universal search `/fetch_search`. Leave empty for the first page; for the next page pass back the `cursor` from the previous response (repeat the same `duration` / `sort` / `publish_time`).

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Optional, default 0 (>=0). Pass `0` for the first page; use `cursor` to paginate (offset alone does not work).

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Optional, default `all`. Duration tier (Channels video only) — `all`/0 / `short`/1 (<5min) / `medium`/2 (5-10min) / `long`/3 (20min+); string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400).

publish_time.title: Publish Time
publish_time.description: Optional, default `all`. Publish time — `all`/0 / `day`/1 / `week`/2 / `half_year`/3; string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400).

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# WeChat Channels Video Search API

Search the WeChat Channels video vertical for a keyword. Filter by video length and publish time, sort by relevance, newest or most liked, and paginate with a cursor.

## Use cases

- Find Channels videos about a brand or topic.
- Discover active Channels creators in a niche.
- Track new short-video coverage with `sort=latest`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/wechat-search/v2/search-videos" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI", "raw": false}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | string | Yes | Search keyword (1-100 chars) |
| `raw` | boolean | No | Optional, default True. |
| `sort` | string | No | Optional, default `default`. |
| `cursor` | string | No | Optional. |
| `offset` | integer | No | Optional, default 0 (>=0). |
| `duration` | string | No | Optional, default `all`. |
| `publish_time` | string | No | Optional, default `all`. |

## Example response

Real response for the request above, trimmed to the main fields. User names and long IDs are masked.

```json
{
  "count": 10,
  "cursor": "<next page cursor>",
  "items": [
    {
      "title": "... #人工智能  #AI安全  #OpenAI  #企业AI",
      "duration": "01:23",
      "likeNum": "2",
      "pubTime": 1791270001,
      "source": {
        "title": "<user>"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Notes

- `duration`: all, short (<5 min), medium (5–10 min) or long.
- Paginate with the `cursor` from the previous response.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [WeChat Search](/apis/wechat-search/v2/search): Search WeChat with one endpoint: official account articles, accounts, Channels videos, live streams, news and more.
